snippet.title: DELTARUNE: SOULBLAZERS Release Trailer
snippet.description:
DELTARUNE: SOULBlazers is now out!

https://gamejolt.com/games/soulblazers/1069233

In DELTARUNE: SOULBlazers, you control the SOUL, and you hold the power to command the heroes to solve puzzles. At any time, you can Eject yourself from your current vessel (like how Kris removes the SOUL themselves) and enter a different one.

Using the power to swap characters, puzzle your way through 7 dungeons, including fully realized versions of both the Ice Palace and ROOTS, in a complete story campaign! Face challenging bosses, use SOUL Modes, and escape from this strange, pixelated hellscape, with Kris by your side.

OST (and this trailer) by @Seeks_stuff 

See you soon!
